reports.headline: Cedar United in talks for Alex Stone
reports.clean_text:
Cedar United are in talks to sign Alex Stone, according to two people with knowledge of the negotiations.

No agreement has been reached, and the club declined to comment when contacted on Friday.

Stone has two years remaining on his current contract.
